facts.fact: The CBN expects regulated institutions to ensure critical payment transaction data is stored and managed within Nigeria under applicable regulatory requirements and the 1 January 2027 implementation timeline, said deputy governor Lamido Abubakar Yuguda.

NITDA and the CBN are implementing the National Sovereign Cloud Initiative, which NITDA director-general Inuwa Abdullahi says is to give Nigeria greater control over its digital infrastructure, with the financial sector first to comply.
